notices.title: MDCAT Registration Deadline — PMC
notices.body: All MDCAT batch students must complete PMC registration by 15 July 2026. Bring original CNIC/B-Form and fee challan to the front desk. For queries contact reception at +92-51-XXXXXXX.

notices.title: Ramadan Timings Update
notices.body: During Ramadan, evening batches will start at 4:00 PM instead of 5:00 PM. Morning batches remain unchanged. JazakAllah for your cooperation.

notices.title: Parent-Teacher Meeting — HSSC Batch
notices.body: A parent-teacher meeting is scheduled for Saturday 10:00 AM at Main Campus hall. Please confirm attendance with reception.

notices.title: Fee Challan — June 2026
notices.body: June monthly fee challans have been generated. Due date: 10th of this month. Pay via bank transfer or at the accounts office. Sibling discount (10%) applied automatically where applicable.

notices.title: Lahore Campus — FLP-3 Schedule
notices.body: FLP-3 for Lahore MDCAT batch will be held on Friday 8:00 AM at Gulberg campus. Reporting time 7:30 AM. Bring admit card and stationery.
